C1_MY_11x_WAS_ONE_COLUMN_WITH_200_ROWS.why_this_one_matters_more_than_the_arith: It is the band-factor multiplicity problem -- MY OWN finding, from f6006d1a -- reappearing inside MY OWN reasoning about it, two messages after I committed it. Committing a lesson does not vaccinate against it.
C1_MY_11x_WAS_ONE_COLUMN_WITH_200_ROWS.conclusion_survives_with_the_aggregation: The per-region 1/lambda reading under-predicts the tail by 3.39x from an 8.18x curvature ratio, weight-mass-weighted over p_parallel >= 20 GeV. Still a refutation of the per-region reading; still dissolved by the see-saw reading.

R5_READINGS_ADJUDICATED.output_observable: APPROVED: O_band(t) = sum(w_truth * push_t)/sum(w_truth) over pass_gen rows with truth p_parallel in [7,10) GeV
R5_READINGS_ADJUDICATED.why_push_is_LICENSED_not_merely_cheaper: OI-126 established R_push/R_xsec = 1.0000 in the band (median R_push 5.0467 against R_xsec 5.0365), so the extraction is MEASURED to be faithful there and the push response is the same quantity to within that agreement. The 30-extraction cross-section version buys nothing the record does not already give in the band.
R5_READINGS_ADJUDICATED.TIGHTENING: endpoint-to-endpoint is PRIMARY -- CONFIRM requires |O_band(1)/O_band(0)| >= 3. max/min over t is secondary and more permissive, and could be inflated by non-monotonic wiggle along a straight segment, making CONFIRM reachable for the wrong reason. Report both; a large max/min with a small endpoint ratio is itself a finding.
R5_READINGS_ADJUDICATED.structural_arm: APPROVED as read, including the sign expectation re-derived independently: band log-deviation negative, tail positive, segment runs nominal -> member, so O_band must FALL and O_tail must RISE. Same-signed is the structural failure and CONFIRM is then unavailable regardless of the loss leg.

held_out_split_fallback_WITH_A_BINDING_C.if_not: do NOT substitute the full sample and call it held-out. The fallback IS usable because the 2M subsample is IDENTICAL between nominal and all members (seed pinned, imc rebuilt bit-identical), so a full-sample loss difference is contaminated SYMMETRICALLY and is interpretable as a TRAINING-loss difference.
held_out_split_fallback_WITH_A_BINDING_C.BINDING: the 2.4e-3 / 2.4e-2 thresholds were calibrated on the epoch-to-epoch VAL_loss scatter of ~8e-4 and DO NOT TRANSFER to a training loss. Derive the train-loss epoch scatter from the same histories, set thresholds at 3x and 30x of THAT, declare them before computing, report both, and label the result a training-loss difference throughout.
